name: Enjoy My Life
source: Step into the life of a young man living with several interesting people, each with their own secrets, and desires. What begins as an ordinary life, soon opens the door to unexpected encounters and new possibilities.
translation: 走进一名年轻男子的生活——与他同住一屋檐下的几位室友个个饶有趣味，每个人都藏着各自的秘密与欲望。起初平淡寻常的日常，很快便推开了通往意外邂逅与全新可能的大门。
